groups.title: Pool Drain W/ Acid Scrub Down
groups.summary: We drain the pool, remove and dispose of all debris on bottom of pool, pressure wash entire pool, acid wash and scrub down entire pool, fill with water, clean DE filters or cartridges (inspect for tears or damage), and add all necessary chemicals to bring the Ph and Chlorine levels to the required level.

about.title: About TEAM Pool Service
text: We’re not just in the business of cleaning pools—we’re in the business of giving homeowners peace of mind. Since day one, our mission has been simple: to keep your pool clean, clear, and safe so you can enjoy it without the hassle.

We have been providing high-quality pool services in the Houston area for several years. With a 4.9 rating on HomeAdvisor, we take pride in delivering exceptional customer service and reliable pool maintenance. Our satisfied clients trust us for both regular maintenance and special pool projects, ensuring their pools are always in top condition. Our team is committed to making your pool a hassle-free and enjoyable part of your home.
Our skilled team delivers immaculate, healthy, and perfectly balanced pools through comprehensive cleaning, precise treatments, and dependable maintenance.
